finn.name: Finn
finn.title: The Crimson Crestbearer
finn.description:
"Hey, Callen? Just in case I don't make it through this—"

"That's not even in the realm of possibility."

"If I... If I become something that's not me anymore—"

"That's not going to happen!"

"But if it does, could you give this letter to Rizette for me?"

"I won't. I refuse to deliver another letter like that."

"Another one? Callen, were you the one who—"

"Fine, I'll keep this letter for you. But when we emerge victorious, you're going to be so embarrassed, Finn!"

"...Thank you, Callen. I'm sorry."

"Honestly! You and that idiot father of yours are two peas in a pod."

localization.name: Linked Edge
localization.description:
300% damage to 1 enemy. This attack ignores damage reduction effects, any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the target from being defeated, skin passive skills and the Counter Stance status effect.

Then give all allies that have Rizette's Link the next turns by reducing their current TU (the user will act first). Active skills that grant turns cannot be used by any affected units until after they have had the turn. This skill can be used on such turns, but will not grant the extra turns.
localization.selected: 300% damage & may give turn

localization.name: Restore Link
localization.description:
Grants Rizette's Link to another random non-conjured ally that does not already have a Link.

Then that ally and the user:
- are healed for 100% max HP.
- have the TU costs for all of their skills reduced by 30%. This will overwrite the effects of other Quicken skills.
- are granted a Sleep Ward, Stun Ward, Poison Ward and Instant Death Ward.

Usable only if no other ally on the battlefield has Rizette's Link already, and there is a valid target. Usable 3 times per battle.

Each Ward prevents their named effect from being applied once, then is removed. An Instant Death Ward prevents this unit from being immediately defeated without damage by a non-boss enemy once, then is removed. Instant Death Wards cannot be ignored. Identical Wards cannot stack.

localization.name: Elemental Cure

Then if at least 1 enemy on the battlefield is:
- Water, remove sleep (including Deep Sleep) from all allies on the battlefield and grant them Sleep Wards.
- Fire, remove burn (including Mega Healing Burn) from all units on the battlefield and grant them Burn Wards.
- Earth, remove poison (including Lethal Poison) from all allies on the battlefield and grant them Poison Wards.
- Storm, all allies who have a current TU of 100 or more have their current TU reduced by 50TU. This effect repeats once for each additional Storm enemy on the battlefield. Then grant all allies Stun Wards.
- Dark, grant all allies Stealth, and a Stealth Shield.
- Light, all allies will be Purified (negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed). Then if there is no Purify Chain among allies a random ally is granted a Purify Chain.

This skill becomes locked for 50TU after use.

Stealth will overwrite other Status effects on affected units. Stealth Shields prevent the next non-stealth status effect a unit would gain while Stealthed from applying. Stealthed units ignore the next enemy attack that would damage more than 1 target. Any damage will remove stealth. A unit with a Purify Chain will Purify another random ally after their turn, then they will pass the Purify Chain to that ally. Purify Chains will end only if the unit with the Purify Chain is defeated, leaves the battlefield, or falls asleep.

localization.name: Instant Link

Then that ally and this unit have the TU costs for all of their skills reduced by 30% (This will overwrite the effects of other Quicken skills), and are granted a Sleep Ward, Stun Ward, Poison Ward and Instant Death Ward.

A unit with Rizette's Link has these effects:

Each time an ally with Rizette's Link gets the turn, this unit will be healed for 50% of its max HP.

This unit has 0.25x of their original Attack added to their Attack while they are not Enraged. This increase will stack with other Attack increases (e.g. 1.5x + 0.25x => 1.75x total).

When this unit defeats an enemy with an attack, if the defeated enemy is:
- Fire or Light, 2 random non-sleeping enemies gain the Sleep status effect for 100TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield.
- Storm or Earth, 2 random non-burning enemies gain the Lethal Poison status effect.
- Water or Dark, 2 random enemies that have a current TU of 50 or less are stunned for 100TU.

This Link is removed if this unit or the unit that granted it leaves the battlefield. This unit cannot gain other Links.

Lethal Poison will overwrite other status effects, lasts 999 TU, cannot be overwritten by status effects other than Burn or Stealth, and cannot be Purified. Lethal Poison deals 2 times the damage of normal Poison, and ignores passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the target from being defeated, other than those which specifically prevent defeat from Poison or non-attack damage. Lethal Poison cannot apply to Burning or Boss units.

trevyn.name: Trevyn
trevyn.title: The Petal Paladin
trevyn.description:
Under his new master's tutelage, Trevyn quickly became adept at using his hearing to compensate for his sight. Soon he could hear a single flower petal fluttering on the wind, and then slice it cleanly into half.

But his teacher's old age soon caught up with her. On her deathbed, she confided in Trevyn that she feared her life was meaningless, as whatever she had accomplished, a swordmaster with sight could have easily done better. Trevyn assured her that her this was not the case, and swore to prove that her techniques were unrivalled. He now travels through Erden to hone his skills and fulfill his promise.

miriel.description:
The Sky of Omens—a supernatural event of unknown origin that occurred in the skies of Erden two millennia ago. The sun vanished, and the heavens blazed in the glow of a many-colored aurora.

Without the light of morning to chase away the demons of the dusk, Mirel and her comrades found themselves unable to rest. When the soldiers around her grew hopeless, believing the dark would never end, it was Miriel who urged them on, and when the sun finally returned, she was awarded the coveted title of High Angel for her bravery.

ja-nafaat.description:
The invading hordes quickly devastated the szi civilization, and the survivors flocked to the temple of Lu'Ganan in hopes that their gods would provide them protection. Suddenly burdened with the task of defending these refugees from a bloodthirsty foe unlike anything they had encountered before, Ja'Nafaat felt overwhelmed.

Combined with his combat prowess, Imran had now become nigh unstoppable on the battlefield. Yet he knows that he must become even stronger, in preparation for when he would meet the dragon again. For this time, the battle will undoubtedly end with one of them dying.

With a greater zeal than ever before, Imran rushes forward into conflict, striving to ready himself as much as possible before the fateful day.

vonn.name: Vonn
vonn.title: Bearer of the Demon Maul
vonn.description:
But Vonn's heroics soon came to an end. One stormy night, the forces of the Pandemonium laid siege to Vonn's home itself. Vonn eagerly joined the fray against them with his maul, and it didn't take long for him to crush all of the attacking forces.

At that moment, the demon in the maul intentionally loosened his grip on the boy's mind, so that he could see what had really transpired. There was no siege, there were no Aeon Knights... Only his beloved family, who now lay dead and broken throughout the castle.

As the truth dawned on Vonn, his mind shattered, allowing the demon to fully claim his soul.

localization.description:
Exchanges 1 random enemy with an Imposter. The exchanged enemy will be sent to the front of the enemy reinforcements. This exchange will fail if the target is Immovable or if there are less than 4 enemies on the battlefield (no imposter will be added).

Then pulls the user away from the battlefield to the front of your reinforcements. If there are no ally reinforcements, adds enough Elmina's (max 3) to the ally team to still pull the user away to reinforcements.

localization.name: Cyber Doubles
localization.description:
This unit is not affected by stun effects.

When this unit enters battle:
- If this unit is not conjured, it will have Hold Ground (If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP).
- If this unit is not conjured and if there are 4 allies on the battlefield, an Elmina will be added to the front of allied reinforcements.
- If this unit is conjured, this unit will Endure the next damage that would defeat it with 1HP. Endure effects cannot stack.

This unit will gain a Charge each time it attacks and does not defeat any non-conjured enemies.

Whenever this unit defeats any number of non-conjured enemies with an attack:
- An Elmina will be added to the front of allied reinforcements. This effect cannot trigger if there are 8 or more "Elmina, Moonveiled Agent" in the ally team.
- Then all charges are removed from this unit.

Certain skills are affected by and may consume charges. A unit can store up to 3 charges and all charges are removed from a unit that leaves the battlefield. All Elmina's created by this unit will have matching Levels, Limit Breaks, Awakenings, Boosts, Potential, Mastery, Weapons, and Accessories.

localization.name: Hyper Drive
localization.description:

"He says he is building a raft. It is amusing, watching him struggle with the trees and vines."

esma.name: Esma
esma.title: Bride of the Sea
esma.description:
Though a demure and gentle ruler now, Esma used to be quite a tomboy, sneaking out of the palace to go down to the docks, listen to the pirates' tales of their exploits, and dream of the world on the other side of the ocean.
\Over the course of her visits, she fell in love with a dashing young pirate; but he refused her feelings. Heartbroken, in a moment of weakness, she prayed to Nautica for revenge... and upon hearing that his ship had been lost to the sea, she realized that she had done something unforgivable. The regret still torments her, but the harsh lesson helped shape her into the responsible monarch she is today.

maxima.name: Maxima
maxima.title: Fiery Princess
maxima.description:
Maxima was quite a tomboy in her youth, and she would sneak out of the palace to play with her friends Merdain and Lucius. She was repeatedly told not to associate with Merdain because of his low standing, but rather than obey, she wondered why people had to be so cruel to one of her best friends.
Spending time outside the palace, Maxima had many chances to interact with common-born soldiers and smallfolk, and she began to question the nobility's focus on bloodline. Why should the house someone is born into dictate their worth in life? Eventually, she realized that she wanted to change her country.

yuki.name: Yuki
yuki.title: Born of Winter
yuki.description:
Yuki made work for herself as a wandering mage for several years. She flitted from noble to noble who wanted the services of the famed Winter Witch, either for entertainment or for war. The spectacle of animating ice sculptures and burying opposing armies under snow was amusing, but without fail, she would grow bored with her master's mundane tasks and set off to find another. Erden, it seemed, held little of interest to a living force of nature. That is, until the Pandemonium began.

Rody and his friends approached her with neither fear nor gold, only a request that she use her immense power to help slay the Eternal. The prospect intrigued Yuki enough for her to comply.

If she'd known how their quest would end, she'd never have dared.

fornaxos.title: Flame Incarnate
fornaxos.description:
Fornaxos spent centuries alone, preparing himself to one day face the godlike Eternal. Now that the threat is vanquished, he finds himself a bit perplexed at his existence. If his purpose was to end the Pandemonium, and a group of mortals completed that purpose for him, what right does he have to call himself a legendary guardian of Erden?

After some thought, he has decided to leave the lonely summit of Mount Fornax to explore the world beyond. His brethren, the five other Legendary Dragons, must be facing the same conundrum that he is, now that the world is free. Perhaps with them by his side, he can forge a new legend to fulfill.

crescent.title: Fledgling Shadow
crescent.description:
"Hey, Luna. Can I talk to you about Crescent?"

"Okay...but why? I thought I finally got him housebroken."

"You really haven't, but that's not why I'm worried. You know that shadow stuff he can breathe when he's surprised or angry?"

"Yeah?"

"I just found a book about dragons at the library. I tried to look up Crescent's species, but there wasn't a single mention of dragons who could breathe shadow. Not anywhere."

"Really? That's unbelievable..."

"I know. Given where we found him, we have to consider that Crescent might not be a normal --"

"Why would a library keep such an incomplete tome of monsters on its shelves?! Such unprofessionalism! I'm going to lodge a complaint."

"Luna..."

norza.name: Norza
norza.title: Blade of the Aeons
norza.description:
The young man traveled the land, seeking the strongest warriors he could find.
As he was already a peerless swordsman, most duels ended quickly. On the rare occasions he was at a disadvantage, he would retreat and return again the next day, until he won.

Those he defeated, he slew without mercy. True power can only be found beyond the boundary of life and death.
Standing over the bodies of his opponents filled him with a rush of power.

Still not enough. I can get stronger still. I must get stronger still. I must defeat stronger foes.
The avarice in his heart drew him ever onward, fleeing from the powerlessness he felt that day.

druke.title: Apex Blademaster
druke.description:
Rody: "We'll need to do something about that dragon if we want to get through here. What's the plan?"
Callen: "I have an idea. I can concoct some sleeping medicine. If we put it in some meat and leave it out as bait..."
Druke: "That'll take way too long. I say we run in there and kill the stupid thing."
Callen: "Don't be ridiculous! That thing will tear you to—"
Rody: "No, he's got a point... we are in a hurry, after all. Let's not overthink this."
Callen: "Not you too!"
Rody: "Look, it's not even a dragon god, it's just a regular dragon. If we can't kill it, how can we hope to fight the Eternal?"
Callen: "...Well...I mean... Yuki, say something to these idiots!"
Yuki: "Just a flying lizard. It'll be no match for my ice."
Callen: "You... you meatheads!"

greta.name: Greta
greta.title: Storm-Inspired Inventor
greta.description:
There's nothing Greta loves more than a good thunderstorm. She goes out in them to take notes whenever she can; she'll drag herself out in her pajamas, if she has to. You must first understand something to tame it, and after three years, Greta understands lightning as much as anyone can. Still, the pouring rain and rolling thunder relax her, so she continues studying anyway.

Storms have always been her friend. Once, when she was very young, she fell asleep reading by candlelight. The wax dripped onto her straw bed, and in minutes, her home went up in flames. Only a passing thundercloud saved her family's lives. She'll never forget how bright the lightning was that split the sky that night.

She's chased it ever since.

The armies of Orcanix revere their Paladins almost as much as they revere the goddess herself. Some have existed for centuries, before the war with the mortal kingdoms. Some have shed the blood of kings, some have slaughtered dragons. All leave legends in their wake.

No coward can become a Paladin. They are tempered by death as steel is tempered by flame. To be a Paladin is to embrace suffering, to welcome and inflict it in equal measure. The goddess lets her monsters lead Erden's conquest, and they have never left her wanting. But she keeps her most elite for a secret purpose, far beyond what her underlings can fathom.

altaireon.name: Altaireon
altaireon.title: Soul of the Storm
altaireon.description:
For many years, he resented and feared his new powers. He could barely control the thunder in his veins, and worse, he had done nothing to earn it. But after a century of fleeing the storms that dogged his steps, Altaireon decided he could run no more. Erden cried out for a savior to break the brutal cycle of the Pandemonium. He was not worthy to be that savior -- not yet. But he could become worthy. He owed it to the heavens that had gifted him their fury.

The young Legendary Dragon sharpened his claws and got to work.

Success did not come quickly. A storm resists taming by its very nature; if he isn't worthy, even a dragon will find himself at the mercy of the winds. After months of fruitless effort, Altaireon found a group of mortal monks living secluded in the mountains. Though they had no power of their own, and no assurance of immortality, they sought whatever perfection they could achieve in their lives. Some wrote poetry, others performed martial arts. Some only meditated from dusk until dawn, pondering the reason for existence. These were not the cowardly mortals Altaireon had seen rise since the fall of the dragons. These were a cut above the rest. In some ways, they were even more than him.

He humbly submitted himself to their teaching, and though he lived to see the youngest of them wither and die, he could not have mastered the tumult of the storm without them.

After losing so much, she finally gained something—a new life. She decided to spend it atoning for her sins. Having parted ways with the other Finn, she started surveying the city for any remaining undead, to prevent this world from ending up the way her own had.
He thinks she should stop blaming herself.
He thinks she should enjoy herself more. After all, life shouldn't be lived for the past, but for the present and the future.
Her co-workers in this new world seem to understand that, though, so he thinks she should be all right, in the end.

The war with the undead started eighteen years ago, but the history of her clan stretches much, much further. Though her village was little more than a farming settlement by the time it fell, it guarded an ancient samurai fortress. The last lord to reside in that fortress met his death at the hands of the undead. Now, like everything else, it sits abandoned.

Shiori has never set foot inside it herself. As bodyguards of the samurai, her family was not permitted within its walls without their master's blessing.

But sometimes in her dreams, she travels to its gates to stand watch.

"My most handsome darling,

Ugh. How gloomy everyone on this island is! Whenever I start to relax, someone has to bring up the invasion—or worse, the rebels. As soon as I get back, you owe me a kiss for each time I had to hear 'Blue Dragon Knights.' I'm warning you, it's a lot! ♡

Wish you were with me, pumpkin!"

In the middle of the night, resort guards arrested a wealthy merchant for treason. Supposedly, his secret correspondence with the Rigland resistance had been pinned to his door with knives. The Endless Phantoms bear no trace of their previous lives. They possess no will of their own and rarely speak. No one living knows why they were chosen for their grim task. Some believe they emerged, whole and monstrous, from the Endless Pyre itself. But they are wrong.

Orcanix's assassins were as monstrous in life as they are in undeath.

She knows they call her a tyrant. In the shadows of the city she fights so hard to protect, she knows her people curse her name.

They have their reasons: hunger, cold, exhaustion. She was but a child when the invasion began, but the living complained of the very same in the world before. Perhaps some things never change. Or perhaps, no matter their circumstances, people find a way to be discontent.

It doesn't matter. Let them mutter and curse as much as they please. As long as they survive their wretched nights, she has done her duty.

Astrid never delighted in destruction. Looking back, she wonders how she managed to build the Rebellion when her heart was so black with misery. She didn't want to hurt Ludmilla. She didn't hate Last Bastion, or its Vanguard soldiers. She just wanted to know why.

It was a simple enough job. A mercenary named Rody hired him to investigate a collapsing mine. Nothing more than a tidy purse of gold should have come of it. But somehow, Cyrus found himself embroiled in a fight to save the world.

The others at Rody's side were good, honest. Not like him. They played their parts in the grand pantomime well, but he could see the Pandemonium for what it was. A scheme.

Somewhere, someone was pulling their strings, and when everything finally went wrong, he vowed to find out who.

gloria.description:
Unlike most Bergarian nobility, Gloria's father gathered his fortune not through inheritance, but through business. His eye for rich alchemical ore made him a talented magical merchant, selling enchanted weapons to the highest bidder regardless of allegiance or creed. Unsurprisingly, this earned him many enemies; Gloria grew up dodging kidnappers and assassins alike.

Lord Valen always believed his daughter's greatest worth to him would be her eventual marriage. He never saw the way she tinkered with his cast-off gems. He never saw the way she found beauty and power in what he rejected.

But one day -- maybe thanks to that lucky star of hers -- someone else did.

It sounds ancient, larger than he is, cursed with history he can't remember. Suddenly, his days with Luna and Solas seem so small, a speck of happiness against a shadow that threatens to consume him. kisara.description:
At first, Kisara rebelled against her master's strictness. She had an undeniable talent for the sword. He'd even told her so. Why did he insist on repetitive drills, boring meals, and hours upon hours of meditation?

He replied that meditation nourished her mind, rice nourished her body, and drills nourished her blade. Should any one of these things go dull, all the talent in the world couldn't keep her alive.

Eventually, she saw the wisdom of his words, and channeled her boundless energy into a signature fighting style. Long before she left her master, tales of her unrelenting speed and strength made her enemies tremble.

Gemina heard legends as she was growing up. Cautionary tales of a priestesses who ran from the temple and caused untold disaster. Her elders used their tragic fates to scare the acolytes into compliance. Gemina, however, would not be swayed.

She understood the importance of her order's neutrality. Those trusted to oversee time itself had a great responsibility, greater than most in Erden would ever have to face. But how could the guardians of history perform their duty if the world was nothing to them but a collection of sad stories?

That is why she ran away. Gemina escaped the priestesses' temple not to defile her duty, but to embrace its truest purpose.

Olive doesn't remember many things fondly, but she'll always treasure her mother's laugh. How she made the most delicious pastries. How she studied her spellbooks night and day, desperate to end the Holy Maiden's witch hunts.

It was that desperation that consumed her. Twisted into a dragon, more beast than woman, she attacked her own daughter, the very person she wanted most to save. In that struggle to protect herself, Olive grew her horns. If she hadn't, she doubts she would have survived.

Let the witches whisper that she's just like her mother, a disaster waiting to happen. She knows better than anyone the price of dark magic -- and knows too that sometimes, that price must be paid.

The ancient dragons of Erden bore grand names: Fornaxos, Kaidaros, Altaireon, Diabolos. All were silenced when the Goddess came, never to be spoken again. Only the dragon who slithered between the stars survived to see the new world.

Ryouma located this beast in his mountain lair, determined to prove his blade could best a dragon. He gave the beast a good fight, but in the end, could not overcome his nimble grace and speed. Satisfied with his effort, he submitted himself to a warrior's death, certain no one he left behind would miss him.

The dragon, having glimpsed the young warrior's true potential, refused to kill him, and instead made him his apprentice.

Her creator could not decide if she should be treated as a weapon or as a person until the very end. However, after Ossia died, she was resurrected by a man eternally devoted to forging arms. A woman made to be a weapon and a man only interested in weapons, both equally twisted—perhaps their paths were destined to cross.
"Who does not work shall not eat," he would always say, so she started helping with gathering materials for his creations, learning all about the world, life, and the give-and-take of trade in the process. Therefore, if there is anyone that can be called her father, surely—

Unfortunately, Tuatha's prosperity could not last forever. Eighteen years ago, its central volcano erupted after centuries of dormancy, burning the village to the ground. As a gesture of goodwill, Luther invited all the surviving villagers to join him in Rigland's capital. Naturally, he adopted the Kau Lana into the ranks of the Red Dragon Knights as well.

But the children of the wind and waves couldn't thrive so far from the sea. Year after year, their population dwindled, as the dragons rejected their new training and fled to the ruins of their island.

Some say those who sail near Tuatha these days can hear their echoing cries, mourning the home they lost.

They led her unit to rebel villages, forcibly crushed to keep their people under Imperial rule. In every eye, she saw the pain of her father's death, and she came to a resolution.

She could not allow this to continue.

saya.name: Saya
saya.title: Solitary Star
saya.description:
It happened so fast. Her car dove off the bridge and crashed into the water below, submerging her, drowning her. It should have been her end, a rising star snuffed out by tragedy. For better or for worse, it wasn't. 

Deep beneath the river, Saya escaped the wreckage and rose light as air, buoyed by the burning power inside her. Something would not allow her to die. Not yet. Not before she'd served her purpose. 

As she soon learned, the Vessels of the Goddess cannot die before the Requiem. The shard of divinity inside her, the Goddess's Grace she'd shown through her dance, had protected her from death. 

But at what cost?

And they're not totally wrong: a little girl with bunny ears will naturally draw more Church attention than her normal classmates. But even non-Vessels can gain an animal's ears or tail, if the Goddess chooses to bless them with it. No. Five-year-old Nanami saw a car hurtling towards a puppy in the road and dove out to save it. They found her downtown a day later, still holding the puppy. That was when the Church knew she was truly special.

After a few hours, she woke up and did what any cat would do. She sought out food and shelter. She stayed in the shadows. She wore a mask to hide her horrid pain.

On the big day, fans flood in from across the globe! Every mode of transportation is jammed to a standstill! Not a single person can make it to the venue!

localization.name: All Powerful?
localization.description:
This unit has a 33% chance to:

- have its TU reduced to 0 after dealing damage with an Attack (1 chance per hit).
- each turn, survive any damage that would defeat it with 1HP.
- ignore the incoming status effects Sleep, Poison, and Burn.
- ignore incoming Stun effects.
- ignore attacks that would damage exactly 2 targets. Attacks that target All allies will not be ignored.
- enrage 1 random ally at the end of each turn.
- weaken 1 random enemy at the end of each turn.

The chance for each effect is determined independently each time they may occur. Enraged units have their Attack increased to 1.5x until the end of their next turn. Weakened units have their Attack reduced to 0.75x until the end of their next turn. These effects will overwrite any existing Weak or Enrage effects on affected units. The effect of Weakening may be diminished if the affected unit's Attack is increased by other effects and it can be overwritten by Enrage effects. Effects that influence TU order may interrupt the extra turn (e.g. Stuns targeting the lowest TU target).

There was only her, physically unharmed, with an incomprehensible voice echoing inside her head. It seemed the deity had refused the call, and decided to hide within her instead of manifesting. From the tone of its voice, R'lyeh got an impression that it was scared of something, though she had no way of knowing what of or why.

The girl Napoleon had been before she became a soldier, and later a monarch, didn't seem all that different from who she is now—and yet, she was not the same at all.
In her own words, she can grasp a thousand facts with a single glance; and with each glance, her mind gets flooded with information. The difference is, in the past it was all she could do not to fall apart when faced with her own uncontrollable intellect and the countless phenomena the world had to offer.

Cleopatra didn't only gaze into the void; she was marked by it.
Within the void, there was a creature of dread and madness. People who lay their eyes on it couldn't think clearly, and those who were touched by it were driven completely mad.
Aeon Lords can rely on their Eternity to heal physical wounds, but even it cannot easily mend a shattered mind. Caught in an endless cycle of death, rebirth, anxiety and madness, Cleopatra eventually forgot even her own name.

At the end of this unit's turn, send 1 random sleeping ally that is not immovable to the front of allied reinforcements. Allies must have reinforcements for this to trigger.

Whenever another Water ally enters the battlefield from reinforcements:
- Removes the Sleep status effect from this unit.
- Grants 1 non-sleeping enemy with the lowest TU the Sleep status effect for 200TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield. This will overwrite other status effects on that unit.

localization.name: Breaking Tide
localization.description:
Whenever this unit gets the turn, if all enemies are sleeping, the next damage this unit deals with an Attack while on the battlefield will ignore any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the targets from being defeated. This effect cannot trigger again until 100TU advances and cannot stack.

When this unit enters battle, all allies will be granted Coral Barrier for 100TU. A unit with Coral Barrier will gain 35% damage reduction from attacks. This effect can stack with other damage reduction effects such as Armor, but will not stack with itself or other ally Barrier type skills.

While this unit is on the battlefield, at the end of this unit or an ally Suimori's turn, all allies will:
- Gain Coral Barrier for 100TU.
- have Burn and Poison status effects (including Lethal Poison) removed.
- be healed for 30% of their max HP.

If this unit is not alone on the battlefield and has Coral Barrier, this unit has a 20% chance, plus 20% chance per Awakening (up to 100% chance if this unit has 4 Awakenings) to survive any damage that would defeat it with 1HP.

localization.name: Attack Up Lv3
localization.description: Adds 300 to this unit's Attack.

localization.name: HP Up Lv3
localization.description: Adds 1200 to this unit's max HP.

localization.name: Sleep Resist Lv3
localization.description: Reduces the duration of any enemy sleep effects on this unit by 20TU.

localization.name: Greatsword Mastery

super-suimori.name: Super Suimori
super-suimori.description:
A guardian spirit with the power of Water.
Enjoys days at the beach.

localization.name: Sleep Attack
localization.description: Damage to 1 enemy, with a 25% chance of granting that enemy the Sleep status effect for 200TU.  If applied, this will overwrite other status effects on that enemy. Sleep cannot be applied to a unit that Has Slept while on the battlefield. Damage from this attack does not wake up sleeping enemies.

Puts the target to sleep, user is sacrificed

localization.name: Auto Guard+
localization.description: This unit is a Guardian. For any enemy attack that would hit 1 or 2 other allies, this unit has a 100% chance to redirect 1 hit to itself instead. This unit will not redirect skills that don't deal damage.

localization.name: Ephemeral
localization.description:
This unit is never considered to be defeated by attacks and does not trigger any skills of other units whenever it is defeated or sacrificed by any source while on the battlefield.

This unit will be fully healed after each turn if it takes damage but is not defeated. This unit will be defeated after any ally or enemy turn if this unit has any of the Burn, Super Poison, or Mega Poison status effects.

Damage dealt to this unit is increased to 2.5 times the normal amount.

goemon.name: Goemon
goemon.title: Legendary Thief
goemon.description: Goemon's Gang's true target was never money or treasure, only freedom. They helped people oppressed by corrupt authorities, earning a reputation as noble outlaws.

localization.name: Fireworks
localization.description:
50% damage to all enemies. This attack ignores any enemy status effects (including Stealth), damage reduction effects, revenge passive skills, and skin passive skills. Damage from this attack does not wake up sleeping enemies. All enemies hit by this attack will become Weakened, this will overwrite any existing Weak or Enrage effects on those units.

Adds a Shadow Double to the next in line of allied reinforcements if a Shadow Double is not next in line in allied reinforcements. This Shadow Double's Level, Limit Breaks, Awakenings, Boosts, Potential, Mastery, Weapon, and Accessory will match the user. Then if 4 allies were already on the battlefield, the user exchanges themselves with the next unit in allied reinforcements. Usable if this unit's active skill Assassinate is locked.

Weakened units have their Attack reduced to 0.75x until the end of their next turn. The effect of Weakening may be diminished if the affected unit's Attack is increased by other effects and it can be overwritten by Enrage effects.
localization.selected: 50% damage to all enemies, ignores skins

localization.name: Stealth Flank
localization.description:
400% damage to 1 enemy, and immediately gives 1 other random ally with a Stealth Strike type active skill the next turn by reducing their current TU to 0. Usable only if the user has the Stealth status effect. This attack ignores any enemy status effects, damage reduction effects, revenge passive skills, and skin passive skills. This skill becomes locked for 50TU after use.

Stealth Strike type active skills are any skills that are unlocked while their user has Stealth.
localization.selected: Damage 1 enemy, may grant other ally turn

localization.name: Assassinate
localization.description:
500% damage to 1 enemy. Then, if that target is not burning, they are granted Lethal Poison for 999TU. This attack ignores any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the target from being defeated. Unlocked each time the user enters the battle from reinforcements. This skill is locked again after each use.

Lethal Poison will overwrite other status effects on that enemy, cannot be overwritten by status effects other than Burn or Stealth, and cannot be Purified. Lethal Poison deals 2 times the damage of normal Poison and ignores passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the target from being defeated, other than those which specifically prevent defeat from Poison or non-attack damage. Lethal Poison cannot apply to Burning units or Boss units.
localization.selected:
500% damage, may Poison
(Will overwrite other status effects)

localization.name: Art of Cloning
localization.description:
Adds a Shadow Double to the next in line of allied reinforcements, and adds another 6 Shadow Doubles to random places in allied reinforcements. These Shadow Doubles' Levels, Limit Breaks, Awakenings, Boosts, Potential, Mastery, Weapon, and Accessories will match the user.

Then if 4 allies were already on the battlefield, the user sends themself to the back of allied reinforcements.

Usable if the user has been on the battlefield since the very start of battle, or if there are no allied reinforcements. Cannot be used if there are any Shadow Doubles among allies on the battlefield or allied reinforcements.
localization.selected: Steps back and Adds 7 Shadow Doubles

localization.name: Master Thief
localization.description:
When this unit enters battle whether at the start of battle or from reinforcements:
- This unit gains Stealth, a Stealth Shield and will Endure the next damage that would defeat it with 1HP. Endure effects cannot stack.
- Other allies on the battlefield with Stealth Strike type active skills are Quickened by 30%. This will overwrite the effects of other Quicken effects on those allies. Other effects that further reduce TU will have diminishing returns while this TU Cost reduction is in effect.

When this unit enters the battlefield from allied reinforcements, it grants all non-sleeping enemies the Super Poison status effect.

At the end of each of this unit's turns, if this unit is not-sleeping, it will be granted Stealth and a Stealth Shield.

Super Poison will overwrite other status effects on those enemies. Super Poison deals 4 times the damage of normal poison, and cannot be overwritten by normal poison. Stealth will overwrite other Status effects on this unit. Stealth Shields prevent the next non-stealth status effect a unit would gain while Stealthed from applying. Stealthed units ignore the next enemy attack that would damage more than 1 target. Any damage will remove stealth.

localization.name: Art of Invisibility
localization.description:
Each time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit will be granted Stealth, and will immediately get the turn by having its TU reduced to 0.

When this unit enters the battlefield from allied reinforcements, it grants an ally with the lowest TU and a Stealth Strike type skill:

- Stealth
- a Stealth Shield
- the next turn by reducing their current TU to 0.

kojiro.name: Kojiro
kojiro.title: Wandering Swordmaster
kojiro.description: Kojiro Sasaki was born into a samurai household. localization.name: Clean Strike
localization.description: 100% damage to 1 enemy. 600% damage instead and this unit will immediately get the next turn if this is the first time this skill has been used while on the battlefield or if this unit has used Sakura Storm since this skill was last used. This attack ignores damage reduction effects, skin passive skills and the Counter Stance status effect.
localization.selected: 100%+ damage to 1 enemy & may act again

localization.name: Sakura Storm
localization.description: 200% damage to all enemies, plus 100% for each Charge stored on the user (max of 500% total damage). This attack ignores any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the targets from being defeated, the Counter Stance Status Effect, and the effects of Skin passive skills.
localization.selected: 200%+ damage enemies, ignores defeat prevention

localization.name: Healing Blossom
localization.description:
Heals the user fully, and Purifies them (removes negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison). The user is granted a Sleep Ward, Stun Ward, Poison Ward, and will Endure the next damage that would defeat it with 1HP. This skill becomes locked for 50TU after use. If the user has defeated 1+ units with attacks while on the battlefield, this skill becomes locked for 100TU after use instead.

Endure effects cannot stack. Each Ward prevents their named effect from being applied once, then is removed. Identical Wards cannot stack.
localization.selected: Gains Endure, Wards, Purifies & Heals User

localization.name: Swallow's Flight
localization.description: Immediately defeats 1 non-boss enemy that has survived for 200TU or more on the battlefield, the user is considered to have defeated the target with an attack if successful. This effect ignores Revenge passive skills, Revival passive skills, any passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the target from being defeated, and cannot be redirected by Guardians. Usable if the user has 2+ Charges stored and only 3 times per battle. Consumes 2 Charges on the user.
localization.selected: May immediately defeat the target

localization.name: Legendary Resolve
localization.description:
This unit enters battle with a Poison Ward, Sleep Ward, Stun Ward, Endure and Counter Stance for 300TU. Counter Stance will overwrite status effects on this unit. The next time the unit with counter stance takes damage from an enemy attack, it will become their turn.

This unit has 80% damage reduction from attacks. This reduction is lowered by 10% for each enemy this unit has defeated with an attack while on the battlefield (to a minimum of 50% after defeating 3+ enemies).

When this unit defeats any number of non-conjured enemies with an attack while on the battlefield:

- this unit gains a Charge. Certain skills are affected by and may consume charges. A unit can store a maximum of 3 charges, and all charges are removed from a unit that leaves the battlefield.
- this unit gains Recovery Mist for 100TU. Recovery Mist effects do not stack. A unit with Recovery Mist will heal for 5% of their max HP and have a 30% chance to be Purified after every turn.
- all allies are Purified (negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed).
- another random ally is given the next turn by reducing their current TU to 0. Effects that influence TU order may interrupt the extra turn (e.g. Stuns targeting the lowest TU target).

localization.name: Killer Focus
localization.description:
This unit cannot be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield. This unit cannot be Stunned until it has defeated 1 enemy with an attack while on the battlefield.

This unit has 25% reduction to TU Costs if it has defeated 1 enemy with an attack while on the battlefield. This increases by 25% per additional enemy defeated, up to 75% max TU Cost reduction after this unit has defeated 3+ enemies.

Each time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit will be granted Counter Stance for 300TU, and heal for 30% of its max HP.

da-vinci.name: Da Vinci
da-vinci.title: Inventor Extraordinaire
da-vinci.description: Da Vinci was twelve when the rumors of her genius reached the capital and she was invited to work at the Imperial Research Institute. She started accumulating achievements, paying no heed to the envy and ridicule she got from her fellow researchers. She provided Bergaria with designs for various technological innovations, such as magical analysis goggles and antigravity engines for flying vessels.

localization.name: Star Sweep
localization.description: 250% damage to all enemies and heals the user for 100% of total damage dealt. This attack ignores damage reduction effects, skin passive skills and the Counter Stance status effect. Damage from this attack does not wake up sleeping enemies. Steals up to 1 Spirit from enemies for each enemy hit.
localization.selected: 250% damage to all enemies, ignores skins

localization.name: Cosmic Cannon
localization.description:
Consumes a Power Charge. 400% damage to 1 enemy, and then grants that enemy the Sleep status effect for 200TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield. This attack ignores damage reduction effects. Sleep will overwrite other status effects on that enemy. Usable only if the user has a Power Charge.

If damage from this attack defeats a non-conjured enemy, another random non-boss, non-Ephemeral enemy on the battlefield will be immediately defeated (the user is considered to have defeated that enemy with an attack). This secondary effect ignores Revenge passive skills, Revival passive skills, and any passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the random enemy from being defeated.
localization.selected:
400% damage, put target to sleep
(Will overwrite other status effects)

localization.name: Astral Ascension
localization.description:
600% damage to 2 enemies, the user is granted Recovery Mist for 100TU and cannot be Stunned for 100TU. Damage from this attack does not wake up sleeping enemies. If damage is dealt to 2 targets, the user will immediately get the next turn by having its TU reduced to 0. Usable if the user has defeated 2+ units with attacks while on the battlefield. This skill becomes locked for 100TU after use.

A unit with Recovery Mist will heal for 5% of their max HP and have a 30% chance to be Purified after every turn. Recovery Mist effects do not stack.
localization.selected: 600% damage, may act again

localization.name: Grand Design
localization.description:
Heals all allies for 500% of the user's attack. The user is granted a Power Charge.

The user gains one of the following effects at random:
- The user's next attack to hit while on the battlefield ignores effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the target(s) from being defeated.
- The user's next attack to hit while on the battlefield immediately gives the user the next turn by reducing their current TU to 0. Effects that influence TU order may interrupt the extra turn (e.g. Stuns targeting the lowest TU target).

Usable only if the user has no Power Charge. Power Charges can be consumed by certain skills to activate or enhance their effects. Power Charges will be removed if this unit leaves the battlefield. Power Charges cannot stack.
localization.selected: Heals all allies, user gains Power Charge

localization.name: Master Inventor
localization.description:
If this unit would be defeated, it instead survives with 1 HP, then until its next turn:
- this unit cannot be defeated or Stunned
- this unit heals for 10% of max HP at the end of every turn.
This is a Hold Ground+ effect, and ends after triggering once each time this unit enters the battlefield.

Whenever this unit defeats an enemy with an attack, this unit is healed for 100% of its max HP and this Hold Ground+ effect is reset so it can trigger again.

When another non-conjured ally on the battlefield is defeated or sacrificed by any source, all allies gain the Armor status effect, heal for 30% of max HP and become Enraged. This may not trigger if this unit is defeated or sacrificed at the same time. This will overwrite other status effects and the effects of other Enrage skills on those units. Enraged units have their Attack increased to 1.5x until the end of their next turn. Armor grants 50% damage reduction from the next attack, then Armor is removed.

localization.name: Adaptive Assault
localization.description:
This unit cannot be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield. Whenever an enemy on the battlefield is defeated or sacrificed by any source, this unit is Purified (negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed) and loses a Power Charge.

When this unit defeats an enemy with an attack, if they are:
- Water, this unit gains Sleep Immunity and all other allies gain Sleep Wards.
- Fire, this unit gains Burn Immunity and all other allies gain Burn Wards.
- Storm, this unit gains Stun Immunity and all other allies gain Stun Wards.
- Earth, this unit gains Poison Immunity and all other allies gain Poison Wards.

Each Ward prevents their named effect from being applied once, then is removed. Identical Wards cannot stack.

Each time a Poisoned or Sleeping unit gets the turn, this unit will be healed for 30% of its max HP.

- A 100% chance to survive any attack that would defeat this unit with 1HP.

masamune.name: Masamune
masamune.title: The One-Eyed Swordsman
masamune.description:
One summer night on the island, amidst the clamor of the festival, Masamune accepted a juice handed to her by a certain foreigner and drank it without a care.
But in the next moment, her consciousness sank into darkness—and when she awoke, she had lost the light in her left eye. What's more, her beloved island companions had transformed into oni.

localization.name: Lightning Strike
localization.description:
200% damage to 1 enemy. 300% damage instead if the target has 100TU or more. 400% damage instead if the target has 150TU or more. 500% damage instead if the target has 200TU or more. 600% damage instead if the target has 250TU or more. This attack ignores damage reduction effects, skin passive skills and the Counter Stance status effect.

Then if the target is a non-boss, non-Ephemeral enemy and had 500TU or more at the start of the turn, they will be immediately defeated (the user is considered to have defeated that enemy with an attack). This secondary effect can only trigger 3 times per battle, and will ignore Revenge passive skills, Revival passive skills, and any passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the enemy from being defeated.

ryoma.description: However, one day, the village was suddenly attacked by an Oni known as Hoshikuma-Douji and her followers. Ryoma was ordered by her mother to hide under the eaves, where she held her breath, remaining perfectly still. When all was quiet, she fearfully stepped outside. There, she found the lifeless bodies of the villagers — including her parents — strewn across the ground.

This unit will become a Guardian for 100TU:

- Each time this unit defeats a non-conjured enemy with an attack while on the battlefield.

This unit cannot become a Guardian from other skills.

While this unit is a Guardian:
- It has 50% damage reduction from attacks.
- This unit has Stun and Sleep immunity.
- Each time a unit gets the turn, this unit will be healed for 100% of its max HP.

While this unit is not a Guardian, this unit's Attack is increased to 1.5x. This Attack increase does not stack with Enrage effects.

Whenever this unit uses Thundering Wrath, this effect is reset so it can trigger again.

Each time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, 2 random enemies are Weakened and granted Rage Wards. Then all non-burning allies are Purified. Weakened units have their Attack reduced to 0.75x until the end of their next turn. This effect will overwrite any existing Weak or Enrage effects on affected units. The effect of Weakening may be diminished if the affected unit's Attack is increased by other effects and it can be overwritten by Enrage effects. Rage Wards will prevent a unit from becoming Enraged once, then be removed. Rage Wards cannot stack.

If this unit would be defeated, it instead survives with 1 HP and then cannot be defeated until its next turn. This effect ends after triggering once each time this unit enters the battlefield. Whenever another non-conjured ally on the battlefield is defeated, this Hold Ground+ effect is reset so it can trigger again, then all allies become Purified and gain the Armor status effect. This may not trigger if this unit is defeated or sacrificed at the same time. Armor will overwrite other status effects on those allies. Armor grants 50% damage reduction from the next attack, then Armor is removed.

chopin.name: Chopin
chopin.title: Maestro of Reveries
chopin.description:
After graduation, the two were conscripted by the RDO and tasked with leading the "Dragon Head Project."
Together, they were able to perfect the theoretical basis for the device, as well as almost completing the construction of the device itself. But one final obstacle stood in their way: the device required a computational core on par with a human brain. This became the single, glaring void in their otherwise perfect blueprint.

In that moment, an answer flickered in Chopin's mind.

—Of course. They could just extract someone's actual brain to use as a substitute.
And with so little time left anyway, she was more than willing to be that someone.

800% damage to 1 enemy. 1200% damage instead if they are a Guardian.

If the user is burning, the user will immediately get the next turn.

Usable only if the user has stored 3 Charges. Consumes all Charges on the user.
localization.selected: 800%+ damage, may immediately get next turn

localization.name: Basilisk's Glare
localization.description:
Burns all enemy units on the battlefield, and grants each of them a Burn Shield. All ally units on the battlefield with active or passive skills that can grant themselves Mega Healing Burn are granted the Mega Healing Burn status effect for 100TU, and healed for 100% of their max HP. This will overwrite other status effects on those units.

Then all burning enemies have their Active Skills disabled for 10TU.

Unlocked the first time an enemy on the battlefield is defeated or sacrificed by any source while this unit is on the battlefield, and is locked again after each use or if the user leaves the battlefield. This skill can only be used once each time this unit is on the battlefield.

When a unit's Active Skills are disabled and they get the turn, they will lose the turn as if they were sleeping. This effect cannot affect boss units, cannot be purified, and will end if the user is defeated.
localization.selected:

localization.name: Serpent's Bite
localization.description:
A random non-boss, non-Ephemeral, enemy on the battlefield that has their Active Skills disabled will be immediately defeated (the user is considered to have defeated that enemy with an attack). This effect ignores Revenge passive skills, Revival passive skills, and any passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the random enemy from being defeated.

Pulls the user away from the battlefield to be next in line of your reinforcements. If there are no ally reinforcements, adds enough Super Himoris to the ally team to still pull the user away to reinforcements (max 4 if the user is alone on the battlefield).

Unlocked each time the user uses Basilisk's Glare, and is locked again after each use or if the user leaves the battlefield. Usable 5 times per battle.
localization.selected: May immediately defeat enemy, pulls user back

localization.name: Basilisk's Ambush
localization.description:
This unit has Stun immunity. Whenever this unit gets the turn, if this unit's Active Skills are not disabled, this unit can't have its Active Skills disabled until the end of its turn.

This unit cannot be defeated by damage from Burn status effects. This unit cannot be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield during an enemy turn.

This unit's attacks heal this unit for 100% of total damage dealt, and ignore any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent targets from being defeated, the Counter Stance Status Effect, and the effects of Skin passive skills.

This unit enters battle with an Instant Death Ward, a Burn Shield, and Mega Healing Burn for 100TU.

Triggered when this unit enters the battlefield from the allied reinforcements:
- all other units on the battlefield are granted Burn, and Burn Shields
- then there is a 20% chance, plus 20% chance per Awakening (up to 100% chance if this unit has 4 Awakenings) for all other allies to have their current TU reduced to 0.

An Instant Death Ward prevents this unit from being immediately defeated without damage by a non-boss enemy once, then is removed. Instant Death Wards cannot be ignored and cannot stack. Burn Shields prevent the next non-burn status effect a unit would gain while Burning from applying. A unit with Mega Healing Burn will heal after each turn at 20 times the rate as Healing Burn. This will overwrite other status effects including Healing Burn on the user, cannot be overwritten by Burn, Poison or Sleep status effects, and cannot be Purified. Any unit that deals damage to or is dealt damage by a unit with Mega Healing Burn will gain the Burn status effect. A unit with Mega Healing Burn will be granted Healing Burn for 300TU when Mega Healing Burn expires.

localization.name: Master of Wraiths
localization.description:
The first time this unit is damaged by an enemy attack while burning, all enemies on the battlefield have their Active Skills disabled for 10TU. Whenever this unit leaves the battlefield, this effect is reset so it can trigger again.

If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP.

This unit gains 20% damage reduction from attacks for each burning ally on the battlefield (up to 80% max).

This unit will gain a Charge at the end of each enemy turn. Certain skills are affected by and may consume charges. A unit can store a maximum of 3 charges, and all charges are removed from a unit that leaves the battlefield.

Whenever an enemy on the battlefield is defeated or sacrificed by any source, this unit heals for 100% of max HP. Then all allies on the battlefield become Enraged. An Enraged unit's attack is increased to 1.5x until the end of their next turn. Enrage will overwrite any existing Weak or Enrage effects on those units.

At the end of this unit's turn, if this unit is on the battlefield and:
- burning, this unit will weaken all enemies on the battlefield.
- sleeping or poisoned, this unit will grant all allies on the battlefield the burn status effect.
Weakened units have their Attack reduced to 0.75x until the end of their next turn. The effect of Weakening may be diminished if the affected unit's Attack is increased by other effects and it can be overwritten by Enrage effects.

manchester.name: Manchester
manchester.title: Exorcist Knight of the West
manchester.description:
She was the eldest daughter of her family. With her parents gone, she had to care for her many younger brothers.
To make sure they could all eat their fill, she prioritized efficiency above all else in her work, heading directly home as soon as she completed an exorcism.
Because of this, more than a few people have assumed her to be an aloof and uncaring knight.

localization.name: Crushing Blade
localization.description:
400% damage to 1 enemy. 800% damage instead every second time this skill is activated while on the battlefield. This attack ignores enemy damage reduction effects and any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the target from being defeated.

Removes Poison (including Lethal Poison) from the user, and grants the user a Poison Ward and Sleep Ward. Each Ward prevents their named effect from being applied once, then is removed. Identical Wards cannot stack.
localization.selected: 400%+ damage, Removes Poison & Grants Wards

localization.name: Earth's Exorcism
localization.description:
All allies on the battlefield heal for 500% of the user's attack.

All non-burning allies on the battlefield will have the TU costs for all of their skills reduced by 30%, this will overwrite the effects of other Quicken skills. The enemy team lose 1 Spirit for each non-burning enemy on the battlefield.

Then if enemy Spirit is 0, there is a 20% chance, plus 20% per Awakening (up to 100% chance if this unit has 4 Awakenings) for a random non-boss, non-Ephemeral enemy on the battlefield to be immediately defeated (the user is considered to have defeated that enemy with an attack). This effect ignores Revenge passive skills, Revival passive skills, and any passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the random enemy from being defeated.

This skill becomes locked for 50TU after use. Usable 10 times per battle.
localization.selected: Heals, may Quicken & Immediately Defeat

localization.name: Mighty Resolve
localization.description:
The user is Fortified, and granted Earthen Might for 100TU.

Usable only if the user has stored 3 Charges, and is not burning. Consumes all Charges on the user. Usable 3 times per battle.

A Fortified unit has 50% damage reduction from attacks. This reduction cannot be ignored by attacks that do not specifically ignore Fortify. Fortify will be removed after reducing damage 3 times since applying, and will be reset if reapplied. This is not a status effect. A unit with Earthen Might has 0.5x of their original Attack added to their Attack while they are not burning. This attack increase does stack on top of Enrage effects, and other Attack increases (e.g. 1.5x + 0.5x => 2.0x total), but cannot stack with Earthen Might effects. Earthen Might ends if the unit who granted it leaves the battlefield, and is removed from units that leave the battlefield.
localization.selected: User is Fortified & Gains Earthen Might

localization.name: Wrecking Slash
localization.description:
Targets all enemies. 1000% damage to 1 random enemy. 500% damage to all other targets. This attack ignores any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the targets from being defeated, the Counter Stance Status Effect, and the effects of Skin passive skills.

Unlocked each time the user uses Crushing Blade. This skill is locked again after each use or if the user leaves the battlefield.
localization.selected: 500%+ damage, ignores defeat prevention

localization.name: Grassroots Defiance
localization.description:
This unit can't have its Active Skills disabled by enemy passive skills.

This unit cannot be stunned or be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield.

Whenever this unit defeats a non-conjured unit on the battlefield with an attack, heals all allies on the battlefield for 100% of their max HP, and ends any enemy effects that are currently disabling the Active Skills of allies on the battlefield.

Whenever another ally on the battlefield damages any number of non-burning units with an attack, this unit is granted Sleep Thorns and has its current TU reduced by 50TU. If this triggers 5 times within 50TU, this effect cannot trigger again until 50TU advances.

This unit's attacks heal this unit for 100% of total damage dealt, will not wake sleeping enemies, and grant hit targets:
- Cursed Sleep for 200TU if this unit has 2 or more Water Allies on the battlefield.
- Lethal Poison for 999TU if this unit has 2 or more Dark Allies on the battlefield.
- Randomly either Cursed Sleep for 200TU or Lethal Poison for 999TU if this unit does not have 2 Water or 2 Dark Allies on the battlefield.

When a unit with Sleep Thorns is dealt damage by an attack, that unit's Sleep Thorns will be consumed to immediately grant the Cursed Sleep status effect for 200TU to the attacker. Burn or attacks that grant Burn will remove Sleep Thorns and prevent Cursed Sleep from applying. Cursed Sleep will overwrite status effects other than Burn, cannot be overwritten by Poison, can be applied repeatedly to units that have already slept while on the battlefield, and will not end from damage caused by Dream Hunter type active skills. Lethal Poison will overwrite other status effects on that enemy, cannot be overwritten by status effects other than Burn or Stealth, and cannot be Purified. Lethal Poison deals 2 times the damage of normal Poison and ignores passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the target from being defeated, other than those which specifically prevent defeat from Poison or non-attack damage. Lethal Poison cannot apply to Burning units or Boss units.

localization.name: Exorcist Knight
localization.description:
This unit enters battle Fortified, and with a Sleep Ward, Poison Ward, and an Instant Death Ward.

If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP.

Each time a non-burning ally gets the turn, this unit is healed for 50% of max HP. Each time a poisoned or sleeping enemy gets the turn, this unit is healed for 50% of max HP.

Each time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit will be granted a Charge, and heal for 50% of its max HP. Certain skills are affected by and may consume charges. A unit can store a maximum of 3 charges, and all charges are removed from a unit that leaves the battlefield.

An Instant Death Ward prevents this unit from being immediately defeated without damage by a non-boss enemy once, then is removed. Instant Death Wards cannot be ignored and cannot stack.
